spec.description: Single-screen health check for the Enterprise Homelab: targets, host resources, NAS health, and syslog errors. Drill into Metrics Overview and Logs Overview for detail.

spec.title: Log Errors (1h)
spec.description: Syslog events at emerg, alert, crit, or err severity in the last hour.

spec.title: Log Warnings (1h)
spec.description: Syslog events at warning severity in the last hour.

spec.title: CPU Usage
spec.description: Average CPU utilization per host over the last 5 minutes.

spec.title: Memory Usage
spec.description: Memory in use per host, excluding reclaimable cache.

spec.title: Disk Usage (fullest)
spec.description: Fullest real filesystem on each host.

spec.title: Log Volume by Severity
spec.description: Syslog volume over time, stacked by severity.

spec.title: Targets Down
spec.description: Scrape targets that are currently failing. Empty means everything is up.

spec.title: Top Error Sources
spec.description: Sources with the most error-level syslog events over the selected time range.

spec.title: Recent Errors & Warnings
spec.description: Latest warning-or-higher syslog events. Open the Logs Overview dashboard for full search.

spec.title: Homelab Overview
